messages:
Lina: Heads-up: Deal desk hit a wall for listing 'EdgeGrid' on Azure Marketplace. Partner PO samples use their internal SKU set (EG-VMX, EG-NET-ENT) that don't map to Azure catalog IDs. Procurement refuses to approve until PO aligns.

Tom: Can you paste an example PO row?

Lina: Sure, redacted: `po_id, partner_id, sku, qty, price, currency`
`PO-90001, EDGEGRID-OLD, EG-VMX, 4, 2400, EUR`

Evan: Looks similar to other cases: vendor alias `EDGEGRID-OLD` isn't the canonical partner vendor id (EDGEGRID-2025) that our marketplace sync expects. Also partner slipped in a custom SLA appendix Legal flagged.

Priya: From partnerships side, quick options: 1) ask partner to reissue PO with canonical vendor id and Azure SKU ids; 2) we accept a one-off mapping in staging so they can run test purchases; 3) finance to accept EUR with manual conversion. Which should we try first?

Lina: I'd prefer option 1 but partner is saying their finance batch makes reissues slow. They offered to sign an addendum instead.

Tom: If partner wont reissue, we can do staging mapping for integration tests but not for production. We should require a signed exception for production listing.

Evan: Legal note: the custom SLA appendix includes a penalty clause that our counsel won't accept. If partner insists, it will delay GA. I'll draft a narrow redirect that keeps commercial terms but removes the punitive language.

marketplace-bot: Created ticket MARKET-3324. Attachments: sample-po.csv, sla-appendix.pdf. Assignee: partnerships-oncall.

Priya: Action plan:
- Tom: implement staging vendor alias mapping (staging only) so partner can validate purchase flow.
- Lina: request partner reissue PO + canonical SKUs; ask for timeframe.
- Evan: propose redline alternative and engage partner counsel.
- Priya: open finance ticket to accept EUR or request USD PO.
Can someone take Tom's item?

Tom: I'll take the staging mapping. Will add an expiry and annotate that it's not a production change.

Tom: Staging mapping applied: mapping entry created for EDGEGRID-OLD -> EDGEGRID-2025 (expires in 5 days). Noted in MARKET-3324.

Lina: Partner replied: they can push vendor id change to next sprint (2 weeks) but won't reissue historical POs. They asked if we can accept legacy POs for onboarding.

Evan: If they can't reissue historical POs, require them to sign an onboarding exception that limits acceptance to test purchases and disclaims GA guarantees. I'll prepare the doc.

Priya: Finance said they can accept EUR for test purchases with manual conversion, but GA requires USD POs.

Lina: Ok, timeline: we can run tests in staging this week. If the partner doesn't finalize vendor id + SLA redlines within 10 business days, escalate to Partnerships Director and Partner Success for go/no-go.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: sync with EdgeGrid scheduled tomorrow 9:30am PT. Calendar invite sent.

Tom: FYI I logged the staging mapping details and tagged @Lina.

Lina: Thanks everyone. Keep updates tight here; if partner signals they will not accept redlines, we escalate.
